programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: Ho Sau, an undercover agent, has been working with Yau, a drug lord, for years, but his job and family are in trouble.

programme.desc: Hassans father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death.

Coming from a well-off family that owns a big culinary business, wealthy SK meets Ceci in a gourmet competition held by his familys company. Despite their different backgrounds, Ceci and SK fall for each other. However, SKs dominating mother disapproves of their relationship. To win over her future mother-in-law, Ceci must beat her rival Jade in a gourmet showdown…

programme.title: The Goldfinger

With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Table For Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.desc: The movie depicts how the fathers forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the fighting spirit through generations.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li Qingrang, a former street thug, encountered setbacks in his attempts to find a job after being released from prison.

programme.desc: A love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races.

programme.desc: Martial artist Liu hides his identity and lives in a remote village with his wife Ah Yu and their two sons, but somehow gets embroiled in a bizarre murder case.

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.desc: Peggy shoots an ad on a deserted island while some mysterious men with the treasure map are also there to hunt for the hidden Ming Dynasty treasures. However, the map is stolen by Star who lives on the island.

programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.

programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.
